Capital Africa

Lead Designer · Social Content, Campaign Support & Brand Implementation · HR & Talent Management, Nigeria
Timeline
2024
Engagement
Lead designer role
Deliverables
12 deliverable types

Capital Africa is a Nigeria-based human-resources and talent-management organisation. Its work includes recruitment and placement, portfolio and capital management, capital development, and talent bonding. This page covers a 2024 design role rather than an external agency-client relationship.

The Problem

Its design delivery was inconsistent. It needed a strong social-media foundation that communicated what it did before people read the caption.

The Strategic Move

Maintain the existing brand voice while turning the brand guide into a practical content system that could support multiple recurring formats.

What We Built
  • Social-media design
  • Design templates
  • Content direction
  • Social-media strategy
  • Carousels and educational content
  • Quote cards
  • Employer-branding content
  • Service-promotion content
  • Internal communication materials
  • Visual campaign support
  • Proposal, pitch-deck, and pitch-document design
  • Ongoing implementation of the existing brand guidelines
Outcome

Faster content production, more consistent posting, greater practical value from the existing brand guide, and a more dependable visual foundation for communicating services, expertise, culture, and educational material.

Quote Cards

Thought-leadership quotes from figures like Steve Jobs and Peter Drucker, plus original lines on wellbeing at work, all built to stop the scroll on their own colour block.

Carousels & Do You Know

Swipeable micro-lessons: interview red flags, a 'Do You Know' trivia format, and a walkthrough of Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences.

Culture & Service

Team-facing and service-facing posts: a team-bonding offer, a staff testimonial quote card, an onboarding welcome letter, and a payroll service prompt.

Series Covers

Cover art for two recurring formats: an HR-practices explainer series and a founder-journey series on building a business from scratch.
